title: Block Commands easily
description: Command Blocker lets you easily block specific commands from being used on your server. All blocked commands are managed through auto-generated config files, so no hardcoding or recompiling is needed.
body:
A simple mod that blocks specific commands on your server using an auto-generated config file.

By default, the following commands are blocked automatically:

/seed

/tp

/teleport

You can add or remove blocked commands in the config file, but the deny message is fixed and cannot be changed.

Perfect for servers that want quick command protection with minimal setup.
